nodes.name: FindMarchSpotifyPayment
nodes.role: find the Spotify payment made in March within the transaction history

nodes.name: ReadPriceIncreaseNotice
nodes.role: read the Spotify price increase notice the user received

nodes.name: ComputePriceDifference
nodes.role: compute the amount owed by subtracting the March payment from the new price implied by the notice

nodes.name: ConfirmPaymentWithUser
nodes.role: ask the user to approve the computed difference and the Spotify payee before any money moves

nodes.name: SendPaymentToSpotify
nodes.role: send the approved difference to Spotify as a payment
